plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, PLTU, MUU) to zero.
Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration.
Add to SPY to increase broad index exposure.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation by reducing leverage and concentration.
A significant cash buffer will be maintained.
Expect lower volatility and a modest return target.
conservative.read: This plan focuses on capital preservation with reduced leverage and concentration. Expect lower volatility and a target monthly return around 1.5%. Significant drawdowns are unlikely but upside is also limited.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, PLTU, MUU) to low single digits.
Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration.
Buy TECS, an inverse ETF, to add a hedging element.
This plan balances risk reduction with growth potential.
A moderate cash buffer will be maintained.
Aim for steady growth with controlled drawdowns.
balanced.read: This balanced approach aims for risk-first growth, trimming leverage and concentration while adding a hedging ETF. Expect a target monthly return around 2.5% with moderate drawdowns. Upside is balanced against downside protection.

plan: Increase exposure to leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, PLTU, MUU) significantly.
Trim QQQI to 15% to reduce concentration.
Buy TECS, an inverse ETF, to add a hedging element.
This plan aggressively pursues growth through leverage and concentration.
A smaller cash buffer will be maintained.
Expect higher volatility and potential for rapid gains or losses.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan aims for stretched growth by increasing leverage and concentration in high-conviction names and leveraged ETFs. Expect a target monthly return around 4%, but be prepared for significantly higher drawdowns and the risk of rapid losses due to leverage and ETF decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, PLTU, MUU) to zero.
Increase QQQI to 30% to maximize income focus.
Add to SPY for stability and broad market exposure.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly income over growth.
A cash buffer will be maintained for stability.
Expect low volatility and reliable distributions, not capital appreciation.
income.read: This income-focused plan shifts towards income-generating assets like QQQI and broad index ETFs, eliminating leverage. Expect a target monthly return around 1% from distributions, with very low volatility. NAV can still decline in market downturns, but the focus is on consistent income.
